note: The Technique Lexicon — the move-pool. Ancient structures and frames fused with modern delivery. This is the Bach-and-Metallica engine: the combinator pairs one ancient move with one modern move. Studied technique only; never the impersonation of a living person.

techniques.name: The Rule of Three
techniques.note: Two to set the pattern, the third to break it.

techniques.name: Misdirection / Pull-Back-and-Reveal
techniques.note: Point the room one way; the truth was the other way the whole time.

techniques.name: The Mechanical Encrusted on the Living (Bergson)
techniques.note: We laugh when the living thing behaves like a machine.

techniques.name: The Sacred-Clown Reversal
techniques.note: The fool inverts the sacred and the absurd to tell the truth sideways.

techniques.name: The Parabasis
techniques.note: Greek Old Comedy: drop the act and address the room directly.

techniques.name: Lazzi
techniques.note: Commedia dell'arte's portable comic routines, snapped into any scene.

techniques.name: The Act-Out
techniques.note: Become the thing; quote it to its face.

techniques.name: The Deadpan List
techniques.note: Flat enumeration; the affect is the joke.

techniques.name: The Callback
techniques.note: Pay off an earlier bit; the room feels clever.

techniques.name: Anti-Comedy
techniques.note: Refuse the punchline; the refusal is the punchline.

techniques.name: The Absurdist Runner
techniques.note: Escalate past logic until it loops.
